{{Top|leg}}
The '''Churt fort''' was an old [[Fortress/Legends|fort]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]], located twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] southwest from [[Hadde Base]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

It was here where [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos]] [[Omega Squad]] made a stand against two hundred [[Maujasi]] rebels. They were eventually rescued by a [[14th Infantry Brigade]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] from [[Neska]].<ref name="o66" />
